answer: Each agent must stake a unique physical asset, like a marble token registered at a coastal wharf, with its serial number tied to one island location. Duplicate registrations are rejected because the wharf ledger cross-checks serials against the island registry. A sybil attacker must acquire and physically verify many distinct marbles, making forgery costly, while honest agents pay only one stake. The Agent0055 deployment anchors trust at QVnYKf9dzW.
